resources.string: No wallet connected yet. Add one to start paying.
You will need to connect a wallet again before you can send payments.

Removing this connection erases its local payment records. If a payment is pending or its outcome is unknown, check the original wallet before trying again. Removing the connection does not cancel a payment. Your contacts, preferences and Hub shortcuts are kept.
A payment is being submitted. Wait for the response before removing or changing your wallet.
The connection could not be completely removed. Try removing it again before connecting another wallet.
